name.en: ZMRA Language Companion (Furigana & Phonetic Reading Aid)
name.zh-CN: ZMRA 多语言助读与振假名伴侣
name.ja: ZMRA ふりがな・発音支援コンパニオン

author: ZMRA Language Lab

description.en: Lightweight multilingual reading assistant and browser extension. Automatically generates Japanese Furigana (振假名), Chinese Pinyin ruby tags, and English phonetic annotations.
description.zh-CN: 轻量级多语言助读伴侣与浏览器插件。支持日语振假名（Furigana）标注、中文拼音上标注音与英语国际音标辅助。
description.ja: 軽量な多言語読解支援ツールおよびブラウザ拡張機能。日本語のルビ（ふりがな）、中国語ピンイン、英語発音記号の自動付与に対応。

features: Japanese Kanji Furigana (振假名) Ruby tag auto-generation with Hiragana / Katakana / Romaji toggle
Chinese Hanzi to Pinyin Ruby annotation with 4-tone marks
English phonetic IPA transcription & syllabification aid
One-click HTML Ruby, Markdown, and Flashcard format export
Dual-mode: Standalone Web / Desktop App & WebExtension (Chrome / Edge / Firefox)
Privacy-first offline parsing with zero data collection
